name: yahwehsworld
description: A 3D globe of the biblical world — every place Scripture names, placed as honestly as the evidence allows.

scripts.build: npm run shell && npm run zh && npm run events && npm run bible && npm run gallery-data && node scripts/build-version.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.verify:gallery: node scripts/check-budget.mjs --profile gallery && node scripts/verify-gallery.mjs && node scripts/verify-redirects.mjs && node scripts/verify-gallery-ui.mjs && node scripts/verify-bible-reader.mjs
scripts.test:routes: node scripts/verify-routes.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-behavior.mjs && node scripts/verify-route-network.mjs
